current_evidence: The council's 'Validation & the Local Validation List' page (tendringdc.gov.uk/content/local-validation-list) links this exact PDF as the Local Validation List, and the document footer reads 'Version: March 2026'.

issues.detail: Householder is shown as '(none) - national requirements only', but the current list applies many local requirements to Householder applications: Block Plan/Site Layout Plan, Roof Plan, Access Drawing, Internal Sections, Elevations, Floorplans, Parking Plan, Flood Assessment, Heritage Statement and Ecology Survey.
issues.evidence: Contents table key: Block Plan, Roof Plan, Access Drawing, Internal Sections, Elevations, Floorplans, Parking Plan, Flood Assessment (pp21-22), Heritage Statement (pp24-25), Ecology Survey (pp26-27) all ticked for 'Householder'.

issues.detail: Several application types are shown as '(none)' although the list has explicit requirements for them: Works to trees (Site Location/Sketch Plan showing the trees p39; Supporting Evidence for Trees p40), Lawful development cert (Evidence p51, plus location/block plan, elevations, floorplans), S73 / Non-material amendment / Discharge of conditions (Full description / schedule of proposed changes pp45-46; HIA also applies to S73), Reserved matters (block/roof/access/sections/elevations/floor/parking plans, Landscaping Plan, Private and Public Space Plan, Ecology, HIA), and S106 modification (Deed of Variation over/under 5 years pp49-50, Legal Information).
issues.evidence: Contents: '28 Site Location Plan/Sketch Plan showing the location of the Trees', '29 Supporting Evidence For Trees', '34 Full Description / schedule of proposed changes', '37/38 Requirement for Deed of Variation Applications', '39 Evidence' (LDC).

issues.detail: Local requirements in the current list not captured anywhere: Access Drawing (where access is created or altered); Internal Sections (additional upper floor, rooflights, dormer windows, or internal changes to a listed building); Private and Public Space Plan (residential over 11 units and sites over 1.5ha); Confirmation of 'superfast broadband' connection (all new dwellings and new non-residential buildings); HMO Requirements (all HMO/bedsit creation: off-street parking per unit, bin storage, management plan, floor plans); Requirements for Technical Details (TDC); Requirements for Permission in Principle; Deed of Variation requirements; LDC Evidence.
issues.evidence: Sections 7, 8, 13, 20, 27, 35, 36, 37-39 of the March 2026 list; broadband: 'All applications for new dwellings and new non-residential buildings.'

issues.detail: Many app-type rows are sourced from the superseded pre-2024 'DetailsofLocalRequirementspdfversion2.pdf' rather than the current list: Air Quality Assessment, Design and Access Statement, Environmental Statement, Heritage Statement (Full), Ventilation/Extraction statement, Lighting Assessment (placed under Listed building consent), Schedule of works and Structural Survey (LBC and 'conservation area consent', which was abolished in 2013). The current March 2026 list contains no Air Quality, Lighting, Ventilation/Extraction or Structural Survey requirement, so these rows overstate Tendring's local requirements.
issues.evidence: Rows' source = .../Planning_Applications/DetailsofLocalRequirementspdfversion2.pdf; current list check: Air Quality 'No', Lighting 'No', Ventilation/Extraction 'No', Structural Survey 'No'.

issues.detail: About 22 rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' even though the list has an explicit application-type key for every section. Examples that are wrong: Landscaping Plan placed under Full but applies only to Outline (some matters), RM, TDC and Discharge of conditions; 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' placed under Full but is an Advert-consent-only section (p44); Arboricultural report ('Evidence of disease and / or subsidence caused by the tree') placed under Full but is the Works-to-trees section (p40); HIA, Self-build, AHS, Transport, Contamination, FDA1 also apply to Outline/PiP/TDC but are only shown under Full.
issues.evidence: Landscaping Plan (p19): 'Outline (some), RM, TDC, DoC'; Supporting Evidence For Trees (p40): 'Tree'; HIA (p36): 'Full, Outline (some), Outline (all), PiP, TDC, S73, RM'.

issues.detail: Advertisement consent and Permission in principle rows ('Block plan / Site plan', 'Floor plans / Elevations') use the document's table-of-contents text as the trigger, and the PiP placement is wrong: PiP is not subject to block plans or elevations; it requires Flood Assessment, Surface Water Drainage, Heritage, Ecology, Transport, AHS, Self-build, HIA and the PiP section (p47).
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'March 2026 Block Plan / Site Layout Plan for Advertisement Consent 42 Elevations for Advertisement Consent 43 Detailed Plan of Advertisement ... 45 - 46 Requirements for Permission in Principle 47 ...'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments that omit the actual threshold: Affordable Housing Statement (should be 11 or more dwellings); Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings or any new takeaway); Transport Assessment (50+ dwellings and/or 1000+ sqm); Contamination Statement (net increase in dwellings/commercial units or recorded contaminated land); Parking Plan given as 'Plans and Parking Plans can be combined.' (should be all new dwellings and commercial/industrial units, and householder works removing/altering parking); Planning Obligations given as 'other relevant planning obligations).' (Legal Information: major development with net increase in dwellings); Flood Risk given as 'It may also be required when a Flood Risk Assessment is required.' (should be Flood Zones 2/3, sites over 1ha in Zone 1, critical drainage areas); Photographs 'alterations), using photographic, map...'.
issues.evidence: AHS p29: 'All residential development of 11 or more dwellings'; HIA p36: 'For all development for 50 or more dwellings, or for any applications proposing new takeaways'; TA p28: '50+ dwellings; and/or, 1000+ sqm floorspace'.

issues.detail: Some trigger excerpts include page-footer artefacts: Foul Sewage/FDA1 row contains '4 Version: March 2026 Any Policy Links None.' and Waste/Refuse row contains '11 Version: March 2026 Please note that drawings are placed on the relevant Council's website...' which is about written dimensions, not bin storage.
issues.evidence: FDA1 trigger: 'where the development is not proposed to use a main sewer' (p32).

issues.detail: Tab items that are not requirements: 'Further Advisory Information enSpacesStrategy.pdf 20 Version:' (garbled link fragment); 'For any descripton, avoid any personal information...' (advice on the description field); two 'Policy-driven requirements' items from the Ecology Table that are just lists of designated-site types, one cut off mid-word ('Local Nat'). The Ecology Table's actual BS42020 survey triggers were not captured.
issues.evidence: Tab items in sections 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'.

issues.detail: Drawing-standards tab items repeat the same scale rule several times ('1:1250 or 1:2500' twice; '1:50 or 1:100' and '1:20, 1:50 or 1:100'; 'include a scale bar' three times) without saying which drawing each applies to (site location plan, roof plan, elevations).

Date inconsistency not flagged: the List date (2026-03-01) matches the in-document 'Version: March 2026', but the filename says 'August 2026' and the council page says the most recent review was completed October 2024. The date is defensible, but users should know the PDF appears to have been republished in August 2026.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'The implementation of the Local Validation Lists commenced 2nd January 2024, with the most recent review being completed October 2024.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current March 2026 Tendring list, but its capture is weak: it ignores the list's explicit application-type key (Householder, RM, Trees, LDC, S73/NMA/DoC shown as no local requirements), misses Access Drawing, Internal Sections, Public/Private Space Plan, broadband and HMO requirements, and pulls several requirements (Air Quality, Lighting, Ventilation, Structural Survey) from a superseded older document.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
